cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Choose the Precedent
cards.instruction: Make someone choose which rule, custom, or prior decision will govern what happens now.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. Who gets the head seat: Grandma or the birthday child? We have traditions for both. Please.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. Fine. Which tradition decides who gets served first?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Serve them together. Except there's only one birthday pudding.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then choose before I bring it in: elders first or birthdays first? I can divide the pudding once somebody's had the wish.
